footballImplementationGuidance.computationBand: Keep demanding mental arithmetic mostly within 10 or 20 unless a completed lesson explicitly supports more
footballImplementationGuidance.placeValueBand: Values through 120 are appropriate for reading and small moves only when a genuine live football statistic supplies them
footballImplementationGuidance.includedBand: Pages through 179 are approved for graded Football questions with guided-first support after page 143
footballImplementationGuidance.sourceMetadata: Workbook-derived families record their exact earliest source page; football-only display and rule literacy is labeled separately and claims no workbook page
footballImplementationGuidance.timeBoundary: Do not synthesize clock, AM/PM, or calendar facts until the football game has a real relevant source for them
footballImplementationGuidance.fieldConstraint: Avoid confusing cross-midfield label arithmetic; use a separate math visualization when football field labels reverse
